get.summary: Get the cost monitor dashboard payload
get.description:
Single wide aggregator for the Cost Monitor overview page: MTD/last-month/YTD/range totals with MoM and YoY change, spend by category, spend by provider, renewals due in the next 30 days, a 12-month trend series, and budget status including providers over their alert threshold.

**Notes:** Admin session required. Expensive: it runs a batch of eight queries plus FX lookups on every call; the dashboard refetches roughly every 60 seconds. yoyChangePct is null until there is at least a year of entry history.

_Source: `app/api/cost-monitor/overview/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: this_month | last_month | last_3 | last_6 | ytd | last_12. Unknown values silently fall back to this_month. Affects ONLY the totals.rangeSpend* fields; the chart, provider table, renewals and budgets are window-independent.

get.summary: List active cost providers grouped by category
get.description:
Returns all active CostProvider rows grouped into the fixed category order (infrastructure, marketing, saas_tools, payments, telephony, mobile, analytics), with any unrecognised category appended at the end. Takes no parameters.

**Notes:** Admin session required. Inactive providers (isActive=false) are excluded.

_Source: `app/api/cost-monitor/providers/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

get.summary: Get a cost provider and its accounts
get.description:
Returns the provider record (slug, display name, category, sync method, default currency, active flag) together with all of its accounts ordered oldest first, including each account's sync status and error.

**Notes:** Admin session required. Read-only - this file exports GET only.

_Source: `app/api/cost-monitor/providers/[slug]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

post.summary: Add an account to a cost provider
post.description:
Creates a CostProviderAccount under the provider identified by slug. Labels must be unique within a provider.

**Notes:** Admin session required. This file exports POST only - there is no GET here; list a provider's accounts via GET /api/cost-monitor/providers/{slug}.

_Source: `app/api/cost-monitor/providers/[slug]/accounts/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

example.error: Account label "Linode - Production" already exists for this provider.

get.summary: Get spend stats for one cost provider
get.description:
Aggregates cost entries across every account under the provider into MTD, last-month and YTD totals, month-over-month change, active subscription count, next renewal date and a 12-month INR/USD series.

**Notes:** Admin session required. Sums the pre-computed amountInINR/amountInUSD columns, so the FX rate captured at insert time is preserved. A provider with no accounts returns a zero-filled payload with a 200.

_Source: `app/api/cost-monitor/providers/[slug]/stats/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

get.summary: Get cost monitor settings page data
get.description:
Read-only aggregator for the settings screen: all budgets, the active provider catalog with its categories, the latest USD/INR and INR/USD exchange rates, and whether the Slack cost-alert webhook is configured (masked to its last 4 characters).

**Notes:** Admin session required. The Slack webhook URL is never returned - only a configured flag and its last 4 characters. exchangeRate is null when no USD/INR rate has been stored yet.

_Source: `app/api/cost-monitor/settings/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

patch.description:
Partial update of any subscription field, including autoRenew and endDate. Only the keys you send are written.

**Notes:** Admin session required. Unlike POST on the account route, no CostEntry is generated by an update. accountId cannot be changed.

_Source: `app/api/cost-monitor/subscriptions/[id]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

400.description: Validation error or nothing to update

example.error: amount must be a positive number

delete.description:
Cancels rather than deletes: sets endDate to today and autoRenew to false, so the row stays available for renewal forecasting and history.

**Notes:** Admin session required. NOT a hard delete - the row survives with endDate set. Reverse it by PATCHing endDate to null and autoRenew to true. Existing CostEntry rows are untouched.

_Source: `app/api/cost-monitor/subscriptions/[id]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

post.summary: Run the daily cost monitor cron
post.description:
Master daily job that runs, in order: FX rate refresh, subscription renewal entry generation, budget threshold alert check, and 7-day renewal reminders. Each step is error-isolated so one failure does not skip the rest; failures are collected into the errors array.

**Notes:** Scheduled from aaPanel: 0 2 * * * curl -fsS -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $LINODE_CRON_SECRET" https://<host>/api/cron/cost-monitor/daily. SIDE EFFECTS: writes new CostEntry rows for renewals, writes exchange rate rows, and POSTS BUDGET AND RENEWAL ALERTS TO SLACK. Do not fire casually. maxDuration 300s. `ok` is true only when errors is empty; a partial failure still returns 200 with errors populated.

_Source: `app/api/cron/cost-monitor/daily/route.ts`_

_Auth: `cron-bearer`_

post.summary: Cron: refresh the USD/INR exchange rate
post.description:
Cron-authenticated wrapper around the FX refresh helper. Fetches the current USD to INR rate from the external provider and stores a CostExchangeRate row.

**Notes:** Scheduled from aaPanel: 0 1 * * *. Same helper as the admin-session route POST /api/cost-monitor/exchange-rate/refresh. Calls an external FX API and writes to the database. maxDuration 60s.

_Source: `app/api/cron/cost-monitor/exchange-rate/route.ts`_

_Auth: `cron-bearer`_

Rolls active cost subscriptions forward: creates a CostEntry for every subscription whose renewal date has passed and advances its next renewal date.

**Notes:** Scheduled from aaPanel: 30 1 * * *. SIDE EFFECT: inserts new cost entries, which changes reported spend. Also runs as step two of /api/cron/cost-monitor/daily. maxDuration 120s. The response spreads the helper's own result fields alongside ok and durationMs.

_Source: `app/api/cron/cost-monitor/subscription-renewals/route.ts`_

_Auth: `cron-bearer`_

get.summary: Cron: ingest Google Search Console data
get.description:
Scheduled ingestion job that syncs Google Search Console data into the SEOMetrics table. Google and Meta Ads are synced separately through a Pabbly webhook, so they are not handled here.

**Notes:** SECURITY: the CRON_SECRET check is not enforced - an unauthenticated caller triggers the full sync and only produces a log line. Note this is a GET, unlike the cost-monitor crons which are POST. SIDE EFFECT: calls the Google Search Console API and writes SEOMetrics rows.

_Source: `app/api/cron/ingest-data/route.ts`_

_Auth: `other: compares Authorization to CRON_SECRET but only logs a warning - the request runs regardless, so it is not gated by the handler itself`_

_Audit 2026-09 (stage): security corrected: this route calls `assertCronAuth(request)` and returns 401 without a valid `LINODE_CRON_SECRET` bearer token. It was previously documented as unauthenticated._

post.description:
Cron endpoint that sweeps unassigned master leads and vendor-onboarding leads and auto-assigns them to vendors. Intended to run every minute from aaPanel cron.

**Notes:** force-dynamic, maxDuration 60s. Side effect: mutates lead ownership (assigns vendors). Suggested schedule: * * * * *.

_Source: `app/api/cron/leads/auto-assign/route.ts`_

_Auth: `cron-bearer`_

post.summary: Sync Linode invoices and consolidate costs
post.description:
Pulls invoices and invoice items from the Linode API for every stored Linode account, persists new ones, replaces daily cost accruals with the consolidated monthly invoice entry, and fires invoice-posted alerts.

**Notes:** force-dynamic, maxDuration 300s. Calls the upstream Linode billing API. Side effects: writes LinodeInvoice/LinodeInvoiceItem rows, mutates cost ledger entries, sends alerts. Suggested schedule: 0 2 * * *.

_Source: `app/api/cron/linode/invoice-sync/route.ts`_

_Auth: `cron-bearer`_

Runs the Linode live-sync job which refreshes the current resource/instance inventory and usage snapshot from the Linode API.

**Notes:** force-dynamic, maxDuration 300s. Calls the upstream Linode API. Suggested schedule: */15 * * * *.

_Source: `app/api/cron/linode/live-sync/route.ts`_

_Auth: `cron-bearer`_

Regenerates right-sizing / cost-saving recommendations for every Linode account and sends alerts for newly created recommendations whose monthly saving exceeds the configured minSavingsAlert threshold.

**Notes:** force-dynamic, maxDuration 300s. Side effect: writes recommendation rows and sends alert notifications. Suggested schedule: 0 3 * * *.

_Source: `app/api/cron/linode/recommendations/route.ts`_

_Auth: `cron-bearer`_

Data-hygiene job that closes unclaimed leads older than the configured age so the unclaimed backlog stays at zero. Shares logic with scripts/close-aged-unclaimed-backlog.ts.

**Notes:** force-dynamic, maxDuration 60s. Side effect: closes lead records. Suggested schedule: 30 2 * * *.

_Source: `app/api/cron/ops/close-aged-unclaimed/route.ts`_

_Auth: `cron-bearer`_

Finds vendors with status "hold" whose holdEndsAt has passed, sets them back to "live" and restores the maxLeads snapshot taken when the hold started. Vendors without a snapshot are left at maxLeads=0 for manual reactivation.

**Notes:** force-dynamic, maxDuration 60s. Side effects: mutates vendor status/maxLeads and writes VendorActivityLog entries attributed to env SYSTEM_ADMIN_ID (audit log skipped when unset). Suggested schedule: */15 * * * *.

_Source: `app/api/cron/release-expired-holds/route.ts`_

_Auth: `cron-bearer`_

ErrorEnvelope.description: Plain error envelope `{ error }` used by most routes. `error` is a human-readable message.

OkErrorDurationEnvelope.description: Job/cron failure envelope `{ ok: false, error, durationMs }`.

name.description: Subscription name; must be non-empty when supplied

nextRenewalDate.description: ISO date of the next renewal

endDate.description: ISO end date; send null or an empty string to reactivate an ended subscription

autoRenew.description: Whether renewal entries keep being generated

seats.description: Positive integer, or null to clear

notes.description: Free-form notes; empty string clears to null

OkErrorEnvelope.description: Error envelope `{ ok: false, error }` used by cron / sync style routes.

label.description: Account label; must be non-empty and unique for this provider

Unauthorized.description: Unauthenticated - no valid admin session (NextAuth cookie), or the expected token/secret is missing or wrong. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

InternalServerErrorOkFlag.description: Internal server error - unhandled failure. Variant for routes that use the `{ ok, error }` envelope.

UnauthorizedOkFlag.description: Unauthenticated - no valid admin session. Variant for routes that use the `{ ok, error }` envelope.

cookieAuth.name: next-auth.session-token
cookieAuth.description: NextAuth JWT session cookie from logging in to the admin panel. On HTTPS the cookie name is `__Secure-next-auth.session-token`.

cronBearer.description: `LINODE_CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token — every cron job goes through `assertCronAuth` in `lib/linode/cron-auth.ts`, which reads only this variable (despite some jobs being non-Linode).

unverifiedAccessToken.name: Authorization
unverifiedAccessToken.description: Legacy customer routes: an `accessToken` cookie or an `Authorization` header must be PRESENT, but the value is never verified. Not real authentication.

adsWebhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
adsWebhookSecret.description: `ADS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, sent either as the `x-webhook-secret` header or as a `secret` field in the JSON body. If the env var is unset the route rejects every call with 401 (it does not fall through to unauthenticated access).

webhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
webhookSecret.description: Generic `x-webhook-secret` header check for an inbound webhook.

cronSecretBearer.description: `CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token, compared with `bearerMatches` in `lib/auth/secret-compare.ts`. Distinct from `cronBearer`, which uses `LINODE_CRON_SECRET`.
